title: Create one Project or Business Inventory Space without unrelated effects

requirements.invariant: Direct CreateSpace owns one caller-generated stable SpaceID in one exact Account and immutable creation scope: a stable ProjectID or Business Inventory. It cannot use copied names, route strings, a nullable scope pair or backend paths as relationship authority.

Space name is leading/trailing-whitespace-trimmed and nonblank; optional notes are likewise trimmed with nil or whitespace-only meaning absent. Accepted interior text is preserved, no unapproved length cap is invented and duplicate names remain valid because SpaceID owns identity.

Direct creation contains only Space identity, scope, name and optional notes. Attachments, checklist revisions, template apply/save, Item assignment, archive, review notes and completion/reconciliation state remain separate typed operations with no implicit default side effect.
Creating a Space cannot create or change a Transaction, occurrence, Invoice, budget contribution, payer, Item placement, price or other accounting state.
CreateSpace is one typed business intent and exposes no generic field map, collection/path/SQL string, CRUD action, server timestamp, archive/completion toggle or backend SDK type.

The complete direct-creation intent is bound to one OperationID, contract version, AccountID, actor PrincipalID and finite client-created time through the shared fingerprint/receipt lifecycle. New Space creation carries no expected-revision precondition and defines no competing queue, retry or rejection semantics.

One narrow backend-neutral Space-creation operation accepts the validated command and returns the shared OperationReceipt or stable failure. Local validation never substitutes for trusted membership, exact Project existence/scope or create authorization.

This Phase 1 command boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free evidence while the shipped app remains unchanged and no Space table/handler, RLS, Sync Stream, Auth/provider choice, source transform, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: SpaceCreationScope is exactly project(ProjectID) or businessInventory and encodes canonically without a nullable pair, display name, route, path or caller-authored Account override.

SpaceDisplayName canonicalizes outer whitespace and rejects blank or noncanonical encoded values. SpaceCreationNotes canonicalizes optional outer whitespace, maps nil/whitespace-only to absent, preserves accepted interior text and rejects noncanonical encoded values; neither invents an unapproved length cap.

SpaceCreationDraft owns exact Account, actor, operation contract, stable Space, immutable creation scope, canonical name/notes and finite capture time; it contains no checklist/template/attachment/Item/review/lifecycle/completion/accounting input.

CreateSpacePayload mirrors only stable Space ID, exact scope, display name and notes. CreateSpaceCommand binds it to the shared OperationEnvelope, derives the Space subject/fingerprint, requires zero preconditions and revalidates duplicated evidence on decode.

SpaceCreating is the narrow backend-neutral operation port returning the shared OperationReceipt. Receipt validation requires exact OperationID and exposes no authoritative created-row/result claim; stable failures cover values, bindings, unexpected preconditions, subject, fingerprint, receipt, local acceptance and malformed evidence.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 contract creates no spaces table, scope constraint, revision/audit column, foreign key, index, view or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No authoritative CreateSpace handler, membership/Project lookup, idempotency storage, audit timestamp or server insert exists.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API and no grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed Account/actor/scope binding is not authorization. No membership predicate, Project visibility check, grant or WITH CHECK policy exists.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local Space row/list projection, optimistic overlay, upload connector or synchronized visibility/readiness claim is defined.

items: The command is canonical Codable evidence over draft, shared envelope, exact empty precondition set, Space subject and fingerprint; decode reconstructs through the same scope/name/notes/binding validators and byte-identical structured restart is required.

Changed Account, actor, contract, Space/scope/name/notes payload, preconditions, command subject, fingerprint or receipt OperationID fails atomically without rebinding scope or adding unrelated Space effects.

A deterministic reference adapter may accept the command into the shared OperationJournal and prove exact replay/receipt semantics; this is not physical durable-store, process/device restart, optimistic row, authoritative apply or offline-authorization evidence.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Direct CreateSpace owns no AttachmentID/reference/bytes/retention behavior and cannot add, detach, reorder or delete Space media; O-023 remains open.

appMcp.notApplicable: No New Space UI, current app service, target MCP tool/schema, transport, contract-catalog entry or app/MCP parity is wired.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase Space document, random nested ID, route sentinel or source export row is decoded or transformed. Later migration must preserve stable Space identity/scope/content or quarantine anomalies explicitly.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failures are contract values only; no signal emission, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook action is introduced.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and its tests and does not change or link either application project.

The slice cannot visibly or authoritatively create a Space, validate membership/Project scope, create/revise checklists, apply/save templates, assign Items, attach media, set completion, archive/delete, write review evidence, alter accounting, choose Auth, define provider/schema/migration behavior, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.
O-023/O-026/O-037, A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016, physical offline verification, production profiling and O-022 remain outside this command boundary.

verification.expected: Valid synthetic Project and Business Inventory drafts produce typed exact-scope CreateSpace commands with canonical name/notes, zero preconditions and no checklist/template/attachment/Item/review/lifecycle/completion/accounting/generic-write input.

Project and Business Inventory commands round-trip byte-identically with exact Account/actor/contract/Operation/Space/scope/name/notes/time/subject/fingerprint evidence and no backend path, provider, credential or authoritative result claim.

Blank/noncanonical name, noncanonical notes/scope, invalid time and changed Account/actor/contract/Space/scope/name/notes/precondition/command subject/fingerprint/receipt evidence fail atomically through stable diagnostic codes.

A deterministic reference port returns the shared queued receipt, exact replay returns the same receipt, same OperationID with changed Space/scope/name/notes is refused, and a failing port returns no success receipt.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming server, authorization, provider, migration or production behavior.

notes: Decision-independent Phase 1 direct Space-create command only. The canonical Space spec and reviewed capability dossier separate direct creation from checklist revision, template use/administration, attachment lifecycle, Item assignment, review, completion and archive. O-023/O-026/O-037 remain fully open because this command carries none of those concerns. The slice stops before physical durable storage, authoritative Project/membership validation, server apply, schema/RLS/Sync/Auth/provider, app/MCP, source migration, hosted resources, production access or cutover.
